dcat_keyword_sm: Border closures, Travel restrictions, COVID-19, Global legal epidemiology, Replication package, Stata, R
dct_description_sm:
Through our investigation into the effect of border closures, we provide a replication package to re-produce our results. The package consists of:
  • A readme file describing the contents of the package and the version of the software it was written for.
  • A transparent, comprehensive, and detailed documentation describing all the variables and source links to download the databases.
  • All codes necessary to re-produce the tables and figures in the manuscript and supplementary tables.
